description.zh-CN: icon=仅麦克风图标；icon-time=图标加时长（默认）；text-time=文字加时长
description.en: icon = microphone only; icon-time = icon plus time (default); text-time = label plus time

description.zh-CN: 用圆点颜色区分待机、录音、暂停、结束和出错
description.en: Use a colored dot for idle, recording, paused, saved and error

description.zh-CN: data=插件数据目录（默认）；music=音乐；desktop=桌面；documents=文档。目录不可写时自动回退到数据目录
description.en: data = plugin data folder (default); music, desktop or documents. Falls back to the data folder when the target is not writable
